words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.ex: I am familiar with this song.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这首歌。
words.en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.tr:
n. 踪迹；轨道；小路；跑道；
v. 追踪；跟踪；
words.ex: The dog followed the track of the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 狗跟着兔子的踪迹。
words.en: A track is a path or route along which something moves or travels. It can also refer to marks left by something that has passed, or the act of following such marks to find someone or something.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；施行手术；
words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.ex: He primarily works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他主要是一名老师。
words.en: You use primarily to say what is mainly true in a particular situation.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.ex: The soft chair gives me comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把软椅子给我带来舒服。
words.en: If you comfort someone, you make them feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.tr:
n. 法官；裁判；
v. 判断；评判；
words.ex: The judge announced the verdict in court.
words.ex_cn: 法官在法庭上宣布了判决。
words.en: A judge is a person who has the authority to decide questions brought before a court of law. To judge means to form an opinion or conclusion about something.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.ex: The heavy workload became a burden for her.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作量成了她的负担。
words.en: A burden is a heavy load that is difficult to carry, or a duty or responsibility that is hard to bear.

words.ex: Smoking is harmful to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is harmful has a bad effect on something else, especially on a person's health.

words.ex: He gave a meaningful speech that helped many people.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一次有意义的演讲，帮助了很多人。
words.en: If you describe something as meaningful, you mean that it is important, serious, or useful in some way.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.ex: The keys are within the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: If something is within a place, area, or object, it is inside it or surrounded by it.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.ex: The doctor checked his daily intake of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他每天的糖摄入量。
words.en: The process of taking something in, especially food, air, or information.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: Follow the guideline to complete the form.
words.ex_cn: 按照指导路线完成表格。
words.en: A guideline is a set of rules or instructions that are given by an official organization telling you how to do something, especially something difficult.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.tr:
prep. 遍及；各处；自始至终；
adv. 自始至终；到处；
words.ex: She traveled throughout the country.
words.ex_cn: 她遍及全国旅行。
words.en: In every part of a place or thing; during the whole of a period of time.

words.tr:
adv. 全球性地；
adj. 全球性的；
words.ex: The news spread worldwide overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻一夜之间传遍全球。
words.en: Something that is worldwide exists or happens in all parts of the world.

words.tr:
n. 高科技
adj. 高技术的
words.ex: He works in a high-tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家高科技公司工作。
words.en: Involving or using advanced technology.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.ex: The outcome of the game was a tie.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是平局。
words.en: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.ex: The height of the tree is ten meters.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的高度是十米。
words.en: The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种商品。
words.en: Goods are items that are made to be sold.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.tr: n. 气体；气态；汽油；天然气；煤气；
words.ex: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 氧气是一种我们呼吸所需的气体。
words.en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.tr:
v. 努力；斗争；挣扎；
n. 努力；斗争；难事；
words.ex: He struggles to finish his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都努力完成作业。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though it is difficult or other people are making it difficult for you.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

words.ex: The bike has a metal chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一条金属链条。
words.en: A chain consists of connected links which are typically made of metal, used for fastening or securing something, or for transmitting mechanical power.

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: He smokes tobacco every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吸烟草。
words.en: Tobacco is a plant that is grown for its leaves, which are dried and used for smoking in cigarettes, cigars, and pipes, or for chewing or snuffing.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.tr:
n. 小睡；打盹；
v. 小睡；打盹；
words.ex: He took a short nap after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后小睡了一会儿。
words.en: If you have a nap, you have a short sleep, usually during the day.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.ex: He copes with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To cope with a problem or task means to deal with it successfully.

words.ex: The new phone is too costly for me.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机对我来说太贵了。
words.en: If you say that something is costly, you mean that it costs a lot of money, often more than you would want to pay.

words.ex: The children are eager to open their presents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们渴望打开他们的礼物。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.ex: He bought a new gadget to clean his kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新的小器具来清洁厨房。
words.en: A gadget is a small device or machine with a particular purpose.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.ex: He watches the Olympic games every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: Relating to the Olympic Games, an international sporting event held every four years.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
n. 责任；责备；
v. 责怪；归咎于；
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.ex: He made a pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了帮助穷人的保证。
words.en: A pledge is a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially. It can also refer to something given as security for the fulfillment of a contract or the payment of a debt.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.tr: adj. 艰苦的；强硬的；严厉的；
words.ex: The hike was tough but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这次徒步旅行很艰苦但很美丽。
words.en: A tough person is strong and determined, and can tolerate difficulty or suffering.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.tr:
v. 想知道；
n. 惊奇；奇迹；
words.ex: I wonder why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。
words.en: To feel curiosity or doubt about something; a feeling of surprise mingled with admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.ex: He repeatedly asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他再三地请求帮助。
words.en: If something is done repeatedly, it is done again and again.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: Drugs can relieve pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To relieve someone or something means to make a problem, pain, or unpleasant feeling less severe or to take it away completely.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.ex: Reading a book gives me relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 读书让我放松。
words.en: Relaxation is the state or process of becoming less tense, anxious, or stressed.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.ex: The renewal of the contract took one week.
words.ex_cn: 合同的更新花了一周时间。
words.en: The act of making something valid for a further period of time after it has expired or been canceled.

words.ex: He will repay the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月会偿还贷款。
words.en: If you repay a loan or a debt, you pay back the money that you owe to the person who you borrowed or took it from.

words.ex: He lives in a residential area near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: Relating to or suitable for residence.

words.ex: He resolved the problem with a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的计划解决了问题。
words.en: If you resolve to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.tr:
n. 撤退；退却；静居处；
v. 撤退；退却；
words.ex: The army ordered a retreat after the battle.
words.ex_cn: 战斗后，军队下令撤退。
words.en: If you retreat, you move away from something or someone, often because you are frightened or because you want to be alone. A retreat is also a quiet, isolated place that you go to in order to rest or to do things in private.

words.tr:
adj. 开明的；自由主义的；
n. 自由党党员；
words.ex: He is a liberal teacher who listens to students.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位开明的老师，会倾听学生的声音。
words.en: A liberal person, system, or policy is one that is in favour of allowing people a lot of freedom in their behaviour or opinions.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.tr:
adj. 道德的；道义上的；
n. 寓意；
words.ex: It is a moral duty to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 说实话是一种道德责任。
words.en: Concerned with the principles of right and wrong behavior and the goodness or badness of human character.

words.ex: The royal family lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇室住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royal is used to describe something that is connected with a king, queen, or emperor, or with their family. It can also describe something that is splendid or magnificent, befitting a king or queen.

words.ex: The boat travels through the canal.
words.ex_cn: 船通过运河航行。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.tr: adj. 功能的；起作用的；实用的；
words.ex: This chair is functional and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子功能性强且舒适。
words.en: Relating to the way in which something works or operates.

words.ex: He works on a naval ship.
words.ex_cn: 他在一艘军舰上工作。
words.en: Naval means relating to the navy, especially to ships that are used in war.

words.ex: His behavioral changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to the way in which someone behaves.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.ex: A dog is a mammal.
words.ex_cn: 狗是一种哺乳动物。
words.en: A mammal is a type of animal that feeds its young with milk produced by the mother's body. Mammals are warm-blooded and usually have hair or fur.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.tr: adj. 有希望的；有前途的； v. 承诺；答应；“promise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The young boy is a promising student.
words.ex_cn: 这个小男孩是个有希望的学生。
words.en: Showing signs of future success or achievement.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.ex: The child is curious about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对星星感到好奇。
words.en: If you are curious about something, you are interested in it and want to know more about it.

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.ex: The law compels drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律强迫司机系安全带。
words.en: If a situation, a rule, or a person compels you to do something, they force you to do it.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: He will consult a doctor for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他将咨询医生治疗他的头痛。
words.en: to seek information or advice from someone, especially someone who is an expert in a particular field

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He conveyed his thanks with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着表达了谢意。
words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. “concern”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book is concerning climate change.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于气候变化的。
words.en: If something is concerning, it causes you to feel concerned about it.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.tr: n. 开始；开口；空缺职位； v. 打开；“open”的现在分词； adj. 开始的；
words.ex: The opening of the meeting was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 会议的开始被推迟了。
words.en: An opening is a gap or hole in something, or the act of making or becoming open. It can also refer to the beginning of an event or period.

words.tr: n. 收集；采集；聚会；聚集； v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的现在分词；
words.ex: The gathering of old books took him years.
words.ex_cn: 收集旧书花了他多年时间。
words.en: A gathering is a group of people meeting together for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 打猎；寻找； v. “hunt”的现在分词；
words.ex: Hunting is popular in some rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 打猎在一些农村地区很流行。
words.en: The activity of chasing and killing wild animals and birds for food or sport.

words.ex: He works in marketing for a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司从事营销工作。
words.en: Marketing involves the process of promoting, selling, and distributing a product or service. It includes market research and advertising.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.tr: n. 印刷；印刷术； v. “print”的现在分词；
words.ex: The printing of books started long ago.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的印刷很久以前就开始了。
words.en: Printing is the process of producing texts and images, typically with ink on paper using a printing press.

words.ex: He finished his schooling at age 18.
words.ex_cn: 他18岁时完成了学业。
words.en: Schooling is the education that a person receives at school.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.tr: n. 加热；供暖设备；采暖； v. 加热；“heat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heating of the room takes five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 房间的加热需要五分钟。
words.en: The process of making something warm or hot, or the system that does this.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.tr: adj. 逗人笑的； v. “amuse”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an amusing performance.
words.ex_cn: 小丑的表演很逗人笑。
words.en: Something that is amusing makes you laugh or smile.

words.tr: adj. 有挑战性的； v. 提出挑战；“challenge”的现在分词；
words.ex: The math problem was challenging.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很有挑战性。
words.en: If you describe something as challenging, you mean that it tests your ability and determination and that you need to work hard to deal with it or achieve it.

words.ex: The movie got a high rating from viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影获得了观众的高评分。
words.en: A rating is a classification or ranking of someone or something based on a comparative assessment of their quality, standard, or performance.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: He was speeding to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他加快速度去赶公交车。
words.en: Speeding is the act of driving a vehicle faster than the legal speed limit.

words.ex: She is currently working at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她目前正在一家医院工作。
words.en: at the present time

words.tr: adv. 深深地；深刻地；非常；
words.ex: She was deeply moved by the story.
words.ex_cn: 她被这个故事深深打动了。
words.en: To a great depth; profoundly.

words.tr:
adj. 每周的；
adv. 每周；
words.ex: He gets paid weekly.
words.ex_cn: 他每周领工资。
words.en: Happening or done once a week or every week; a newspaper or magazine that is published once a week.

words.tr: adv. 自然地；理所当然地；
words.ex: Babies cry naturally when they are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿饿了时会自然地哭。
words.en: in a natural manner; as a matter of course; by nature

words.ex: He rarely eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: Not often; seldom.

words.ex: There are roughly 100 students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级大约有100名学生。
words.en: In a manner that is not exact or detailed; approximately.

words.ex: He barely slept last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚几乎没睡觉。
words.en: You use barely to say that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.ex: The teacher gave timely help when I was stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当我遇到困难时，老师及时提供了帮助。
words.en: done or occurring at a favorable or useful time; opportune.

words.ex: He is merely a student.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅是个学生。
words.en: You use merely to emphasize that something is only what you say and not better, more important, or more exciting.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.tr:
adj. 每月的；每月一次的；
n. 月刊；
adv. 每月一次；每个月；
words.ex: He pays his rent monthly.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付房租。
words.en: Monthly means happening or done once a month or every month.

words.ex: He solely depends on his bike to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他只靠自行车去上班。
words.en: If something is solely the case, it is the only thing that is the case.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.ex: The weather will deteriorate tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天天气会恶化。
words.en: If something deteriorates, it becomes worse in some way.

words.ex: He donate money to the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他向贫困儿童捐赠钱。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization that needs help.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.ex: The bridge is stable and safe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥很稳固，可以安全通过。
words.en: If something is stable, it is not likely to change or come to an end suddenly.

words.ex: He steers the team toward success.
words.ex_cn: 他引导团队走向成功。
words.en: To steer a vehicle, ship, or aircraft is to control its direction.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: The stability of the table prevents it from wobbling.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的固定防止它摇晃。
words.en: The state of being stable; the quality of being unchanging.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.ex: The doctor tried to stabilize the patient's heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 医生试图稳定病人的脉搏。
words.en: To stabilize something means to make it stable or to prevent it from changing or declining.

words.ex: The doctor gave medicine to stabilise his blood pressure.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了药来稳定他的血压。
words.en: To stabilise something means to make it stable or to prevent it from changing or declining.

words.ex: The bread is stale because it was left out too long.
words.ex_cn: 面包不新鲜了，因为它放得太久。
words.en: If food or air is stale, it is no longer fresh and therefore unpleasant.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread at the grocery.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocery is a store where food and small items for the house are sold.

words.ex: He wore a crazy hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶疯狂的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as crazy, you mean that they are very enthusiastic or excited about something.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.tr: adj. 黑暗的；幽暗的；忧郁的；沮丧的
words.ex: The room was gloomy with no windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有窗户，很黑暗。
words.en: If a place is gloomy, it is almost dark so that you cannot see very well. If people are gloomy, they are unhappy and have no hope.

words.ex: It's risky to walk alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 晚上独自走路是危险的。
words.en: If an activity or action is risky, it is dangerous or likely to fail.

words.tr:
adj. 稳定的；
v. 使稳住；
words.ex: The boat moved in a steady way on the calm sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在平静的海面上平稳地移动。
words.en: If something is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about. If you steady something, you stop it from shaking or moving about.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.tr: adj. 有缺陷的；有故障的；有错误的；
words.ex: The faulty phone keeps turning off.
words.ex_cn: 这部有缺陷的手机总是自动关机。
words.en: If you describe something as faulty, you mean that it is not perfect or it has some weaknesses.

words.tr: adj. 朦胧的；模糊的；不清楚的
words.ex: The sky looks hazy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上天空看起来雾蒙蒙的。
words.en: If it is hazy, it is not clear because there is a lot of mist, smoke, or dust in the air.

words.ex: He achieved mastery of the piano after ten years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 他经过十年的练习，熟练掌握了钢琴。
words.en: If you show mastery of a particular skill or language, you show that you have learned or understood it completely and have no difficulty using it.

words.ex: The needy family received food from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫穷的家庭从慈善机构收到了食物。
words.en: Needy people do not have enough food, medicine, or clothing, or adequate houses.

words.ex: This puzzle is tricky for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜题对孩子来说很棘手。
words.en: If you describe a task or problem as tricky, you mean that it is difficult to deal with and requires careful thinking or skill.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.ex: The loud music was a distraction while I tried to study.
words.ex_cn: 当我试图学习时，大声的音乐让我分心。
words.en: Something that makes it difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.ex: He works in a technical department.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个技术部门工作。
words.en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

words.ex: He learned a new technique to paint better.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一种新的绘画技术。
words.en: A technique is a particular method of doing an activity, usually a method that involves practical skills.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.tr: v. 使社会化；进行社交活动；与人交往
words.ex: The school helps children socialize with others.
words.ex_cn: 学校帮助孩子们与他人社会化。
words.en: If you socialize, you meet other people socially, for example at parties.

words.ex: Children learn to socialise at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校学习进行社交活动。
words.en: To socialise means to participate or to cause someone to participate in social activities; to make someone behave in a way that is acceptable to their society.

words.tr:
v. 把…联系在一起；
adj. 副的；
n. 同事；伙伴；
words.ex: He associates happiness with family time.
words.ex_cn: 他把幸福与家庭时光联系在一起。
words.en: If you associate someone or something with a particular quality or idea, or if they are associated with it, you connect them in your mind with that quality or idea.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.ex: I truly appreciate your help.
words.ex_cn: 我衷心感谢你的帮助。
words.en: You use truly to emphasize that something has all the features or qualities of a particular thing, or is the case to the fullest possible extent.

words.ex: They play basketball in the gymnasium.
words.ex_cn: 他们在体育馆打篮球。
words.en: A gymnasium is a large room or building with equipment for exercising the body and increasing strength.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.ex: He stood amid the trees, quiet and still.
words.ex_cn: 他站在树木中间，安静而静止。
words.en: If something is amid other things, it is surrounded by them.

words.ex: The movie aroused his curiosity.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影激起了他的好奇心。
words.en: If something arouses a particular reaction or attitude in people, it causes them to have that reaction or attitude.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.ex: The donor gave money to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 捐赠者向医院捐了钱。
words.en: A donor is a person or organization that gives something, especially money, to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: The doctor found a tumour in his lung.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的肺里发现了一个肿瘤。
words.en: A tumour is a mass of tissue that's formed by an accumulation of abnormal cells. Normally, the cells in your body age, die, and are replaced by new cells. With cancer and other tumours, something disrupts this cycle. Tumour cells grow, even though the body does not need them, and unlike normal old cells, they don't die. As this process goes on, the tumour continues to grow as more and more cells are added to the mass.

words.ex: The doctor found a tumor in his lung.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的肺里发现了一个肿瘤。
words.en: A tumor is a mass of tissue that's formed by an accumulation of abnormal cells. Normally, the cells in your body age, die, and are replaced by new cells. With cancer and other tumors, something disrupts this cycle. Tumor cells grow, even though the body does not need them, and unlike normal old cells, they don't die. As this process goes on, the tumor continues to grow as more and more cells are added to the mass.

words.tr: v. 调整；使适合；使适应；
words.ex: He adjusted the chair to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了椅子以便坐得舒服。
words.en: To adjust something means to change it so that it is more effective or appropriate, or so that it fits better.

words.ex: He made an adjustment to live in the new city.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了适应以适应新城市的生活。
words.en: An adjustment is a small change that is made to something such as a machine or a way of doing something.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.ex: He injured his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: To injure someone means to cause them physical harm, for example in an accident or an attack.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: He faced a dilemma: stay home or go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困境：是待在家里还是去上班。
words.en: A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: He noticed the discrimination between the two prices.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了两个价格之间的区别。
words.en: The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.ex: Don't discourage him from trying.
words.ex_cn: 不要阻止他尝试。
words.en: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: There was a disagreement about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 关于这个计划，他们产生了分歧。
words.en: A disagreement is a situation in which people have different opinions about something and often argue.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

words.ex: She insists on going home now.
words.ex_cn: 她坚决要求现在回家。
words.en: If you insist on doing something, you keep doing it, even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: He tried to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.ex: He made a persistent effort to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他持续努力学习英语。
words.en: Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition.

words.ex: He asked for assistance with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他请求帮助做作业。
words.en: The act of helping or supporting someone or something.

words.ex: The rain persisted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨持续了一整天。
words.en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.tr: n. 投稿人；贡献者；因素；
words.ex: He is a contributor to the local newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地报纸的投稿人。
words.en: A contributor is someone who gives something, such as money, time, or ideas, to help achieve or provide something.

words.tr: n. 计划；规划； v. 计划；打算；“plan”的现在分词；
words.ex: The planning for the trip took a week.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的计划花了一周时间。
words.en: The process of making plans for something.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.tr: n. 心理学家；心理学研究者；
words.ex: The psychologist helped the child feel less afraid.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家帮助孩子感觉不那么害怕。
words.en: A psychologist is a person who studies the human mind and human emotions and behaviour, and who uses this knowledge to help people with mental health problems.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: The investor gave money to the new business.
words.ex_cn: 这位投资者为这家新企业提供了资金。
words.en: An investor is a person or organization that puts money into financial schemes, property, etc. with the expectation of achieving a profit.

words.ex: He caught influenza last winter.
words.ex_cn: 他去年冬天得了流感。
words.en: Influenza is an infectious disease caused by the influenza virus, characterized by fever, sore throat, muscle pain, severe headache, coughing, and weakness.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: The incidence of flu increased last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天流感的发生率上升了。
words.en: The incidence of something is the frequency with which it occurs or the rate at which it happens.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: The movie was incredibly funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极其搞笑。
words.en: In a manner that is difficult to believe; extremely.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.ex: The price of bread went up because of inflation.
words.ex_cn: 由于通货膨胀，面包的价格上涨了。
words.en: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.ex: The inner room is quiet and dark.
words.ex_cn: 内部的房间安静而昏暗。
words.en: Located inside or further in; relating to the mind or spirit.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.ex: The invasion of privacy is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 侵犯隐私是一个严重的问题。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.ex: He is invariably late for meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他总是开会迟到。
words.en: If something invariably happens or is invariably true, it always happens or is always true.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.ex: He is impatient when he waits for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时很不耐烦。
words.en: If you are impatient, you are easily annoyed by delays or by people making mistakes.

words.ex: His smile left a good impression on me.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑给我留下了好印象。
words.en: An idea, feeling, or opinion about something or someone, especially one formed without conscious thought or on the basis of little evidence.

words.ex: He acted on impulse and bought the car.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了那辆车。
words.en: An impulse is a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about the consequences.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.ex: The evidence is doubtful.
words.ex_cn: 这些证据是可疑的。
words.en: If you are doubtful about something, you are uncertain about it or not sure that it is true or possible.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is painful.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口很疼。
words.en: If something is painful, it causes you a lot of physical or emotional pain.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.ex: A handful of students stayed after class to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 少数学生课后留下来提问。
words.en: A handful of something is a small amount of it, especially when it is not enough or when it is difficult to manage.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.ex: The company is bankrupt after losing all its money.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司失去所有钱后破产了。
words.en: If a person or a company is bankrupt, they have been declared by a court of law to be unable to pay their debts.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.ex: He fixed the electrical wire with tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶带修好了电线。
words.en: Relating to electricity or things that use electricity.

words.ex: The electric lamp lights up the room.
words.ex_cn: 电灯照亮了房间。
words.en: Something that is electric works by means of electricity, is powered by electricity, or produces electricity.

words.ex: He fixed the broken electronics with a small tool.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小工具修好了坏掉的电子器件。
words.en: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors and microchips, and with the behavior and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor, vacuum, or gas.

words.tr: adj. 急剧的；引人注目的；戏剧（性）的；
words.ex: There was a dramatic increase in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度急剧上升。
words.en: If something is dramatic, it happens or changes suddenly and noticeably.

words.tr: adv. 急剧地；引人注目地；
words.ex: The temperature dropped dramatically overnight.
words.ex_cn: 夜间温度急剧下降。
words.en: In a way that is sudden, noticeable, or significant, often in a way that is intended to produce a strong effect.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.ex: Parental love is very important for children.
words.ex_cn: 父母的爱对孩子非常重要。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a parent or parents.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: The prohibition of smoking in public places improved air quality.
words.ex_cn: 在公共场所禁止吸烟改善了空气质量。
words.en: Prohibition is the act of forbidding something, especially by law.

words.tr: adj. 革新的；富有革新精神的；
words.ex: The company made an innovative phone.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司推出了一款革新的手机。
words.en: Something that is innovative is new and original, especially in the way that it is done.

words.ex: The company wants to innovate its production process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想改革它的生产流程。
words.en: To innovate means to introduce changes and new ideas in the way something is done or made.

words.ex: They will renovate the old house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月将翻新那栋老房子。
words.en: To renovate means to restore something to a good state of repair or to make it as good as new.

words.ex: The renovation of the old house took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的革新花了三个月。
words.en: The act of improving by renewing and restoring.

words.ex: The immigrant found a job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移民在城市里找到了一份工作。
words.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.ex: Birds begin migration in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在秋天开始迁徙。
words.en: The movement of people, animals, or birds from one place to another, especially regularly according to the seasons.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.tr: n. 广告活动；广告业； v. 做广告；“advertise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: The activity of producing advertisements for commercial products or services.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.tr: adj. 无可置疑的；决定性的；
words.ex: The evidence was conclusive.
words.ex_cn: 证据是无可置疑的。
words.en: If something is conclusive, it means that it proves something in a way that is certain and leaves no doubt.

words.ex: This brand has an exclusive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个品牌拥有独有的设计。
words.en: Something that is exclusive is available only to particular people, and not to everyone.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.ex: There is uncertainty about the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天的天气还不确定。
