words.en: A chemical element that is a light, silver-coloured metal, used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: The fence is a barrier to animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏是动物的障碍。
words.en: A barrier is something such as a rule, law, or policy that makes it difficult or impossible for something to happen or be achieved.

words.ex: He poured water into a wooden barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进一个木桶里。
words.en: A barrel is a large, round container for liquids or food, typically made of wood or metal.

words.ex: He felt embarrassment when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前绊倒时感到窘迫。
words.en: A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.

words.ex: His acceptance of the offer made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了这份提议，让大家都很高兴。
words.en: The act of agreeing to receive or undertake something offered.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；罕见的；特别的；
words.ex: She is an exceptional student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名卓越的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: An exceptional person or thing has some unusual quality or ability that makes them different from others.

words.tr: adj. 善于接受的；能接纳的；
words.ex: He is receptive to new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他善于接受新想法。
words.en: Willing to consider or accept new suggestions and ideas.

words.ex: The municipality cleaned the streets last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个自治市上周清理了街道。
words.en: A municipality is a city or town that has its own government to manage local affairs.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.ex: He is the recipient of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个奖项的接受者。
words.en: A recipient is a person who receives something.

words.ex: He tied the box with a red cord.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根红绳把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A cord is a thick string or thin rope made of twisted strands, or something resembling such a string or rope in appearance or function.

words.ex: He was late, so he left accordingly.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，于是相应地提前出发了。
words.en: In a way that is appropriate to the particular circumstances.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.ex: Honesty is a great virtue.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
words.en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: The two countries formed an alliance to fight the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成联盟以对抗敌人。
words.en: An alliance is a group of countries or political parties that are formally united and working together because they have similar aims.

words.tr: adj. 有（法律）责任的；有…倾向的；
words.ex: He is liable for the damage caused by his car.
words.ex_cn: 他对他的车造成的损害负有责任。
words.en: If you are liable for something such as a debt or a duty, you are legally responsible for it. If something is liable to happen, it is very likely to happen.

words.ex: The elite of the city often meet at private clubs.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的精英经常在私人俱乐部会面。
words.en: You can refer to the most powerful, rich, or talented people within a particular group, place, or society as the elite.

words.ex: He shows diligence in doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天认真完成作业。
words.en: Conscientiousness in paying proper attention to a task; giving the degree of care required in a given situation.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.tr: v. 辞职；使…顺从于（做）某事；
words.ex: He decided to resign from his job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you resign from a job or position, you formally announce that you are leaving it.

words.ex: He handed in his resignation last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周递交了辞职信。
words.en: The act of giving up a job or position in a formal or official way; also refers to the acceptance of something undesirable but inevitable.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.ex: The loud music distract me from my homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心做作业。
words.en: If something distracts you or your attention, it makes you stop concentrating on what you are doing.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: This small enterprise makes handmade toys.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业生产手工玩具。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one, or a difficult or important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and organization.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his team.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的团队发言。
words.en: If you do something on someone's behalf, you do it for that person as their representative.

words.ex: He devised a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: To devise something means to plan or invent a new way of doing something.

words.tr: n. 小提琴手；小提琴演奏者；
words.ex: The violinist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手在音乐会上演奏了一首优美的曲子。
words.en: A violinist is a person who plays the violin.

words.ex: He is a physicist who studies stars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位研究恒星的物理学家。
words.en: A physicist is a scientist who specializes in the field of physics, which is the study of matter, energy, and the fundamental forces of nature.

words.ex: There is no certainty that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天是否会下雨还没有确定。
words.en: Something that is certain is sure to happen or is definitely true.

words.ex: The royalty lived in a large palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇族住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royalty refers to people of royal blood or status, or a sum of money paid to an author, composer, etc., for each copy of a work sold or for each public performance of their work.

words.tr:
adv. 向下地；
adj. 向下的；
words.ex: The leaves fell downward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 树叶慢慢向下飘落。
words.en: Moving or leading towards a lower place or level

words.ex: The outward force pushed the door open.
words.ex_cn: 向外的力把门推开了。
words.en: An outward movement or position is one that is directed towards the outside or away from the centre.

words.ex: We ate dinner, and afterward we watched a movie.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃了晚饭，之后看了部电影。
words.en: If you do something or if something happens afterward, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned.

words.tr:
adv. 向后地；
adj. 向后的；
words.ex: He walked backward to see the sign.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走以便看清楚那个标志。
words.en: If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: He walked backwards to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走到门边。
words.en: If you move or look backwards, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a clinical exam.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他做了临床检查。
words.en: Clinical means involving or relating to the direct observation and treatment of patients, rather than theoretical or laboratory studies.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.ex: The princess lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 公主住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A princess is a female member of a royal family, especially a daughter or granddaughter of a king and queen, or the wife of a prince.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.tr:
v. 撞；碰上；颠簸行进；
n. 碰撞；猛击；肿块；凸块；
words.ex: He bumped the table and spilled his drink.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到了桌子，打翻了饮料。
words.en: If you bump into something or someone, you accidentally hit them while you are moving.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.tr: v. 学习；“learn”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有学问的；
words.ex: He learned to read when he was five.
words.ex_cn: 他五岁时学会了阅读。
words.en: A learned person has gained a lot of knowledge by studying.

words.ex: The occurrence of rain surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 下雨这件事让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An occurrence is something that happens or takes place.

words.ex: The doctor sensed the urgency and acted quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生感受到了紧急情况，迅速采取了行动。
words.en: The quality or condition of being urgent; pressing importance.

words.ex: She sewed a button on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗纽扣缝在了外套上。
words.en: A button is a small, usually round object that you press to operate a device or a machine, or a small, round object that you fasten to clothing to keep it closed.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.ex: The loud noise frightened the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something or someone frightens you, they cause you to suddenly feel afraid, anxious, or nervous.

words.ex: The rain dampened the sound of the drums.
words.ex_cn: 雨减弱了鼓声。
words.en: To dampen something means to make it slightly wet, or to make it less strong or intense.

words.ex: The drunken man stumbled down the street.
words.ex_cn: 那个醉汉摇摇晃晃地走在街上。
words.en: Someone who is drunken is drunk or frequently gets drunk.

words.ex: He tried to loosen the tight screw.
words.ex_cn: 他试图拧松那颗紧的螺丝。
words.en: If you loosen something or if it loosens, it becomes less tight, less firmly fixed, or less strongly attached.

words.ex: The sun softened the ice on the road.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使路上的冰变软了。
words.en: To make or become soft or softer.

words.ex: The wind stiffened the cloth on the line.
words.ex_cn: 风把晾衣绳上的布吹硬了。
words.en: to make or become stiff or rigid; to make or become more severe or strict

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

words.tr:
v. 惊异于；惊异；
n. 令人惊异的人（或事）；
words.ex: I marvel at how fast she runs.
words.ex_cn: 我惊异于她跑得有多快。
words.en: If you marvel at something, you express your great surprise, wonder, or admiration.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.tr:
v. 争吵；吵架；
n. 争吵；口角；
words.ex: They quarrel over small things every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天为小事争吵。
words.en: A quarrel is an angry argument or disagreement between people.

words.ex: It rained all day, hence the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use hence to indicate that the statement you are about to make is a consequence of what you have just said.

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是动物王国之王。
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.tr:
adj. 集体的；
n. 集体；
words.ex: The collective decision was made by all members.
words.ex_cn: 这个集体决定是由所有成员做出的。
words.en: done or shared by all members of a group of people

words.ex: The selection of books was very good.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的选择非常好。
words.en: The act of carefully choosing someone or something as the best or most suitable.

words.ex: He computes the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快算出总成本。
words.en: If you compute a total, amount, or result, you calculate it.

words.tr: v. 使计算机化；用计算机做
words.ex: The school will computerize its records next year.
words.ex_cn: 学校明年将把记录电脑化。
words.en: To computerize something means to use computers to control or operate it, or to change something so that it can be controlled or operated by computers.

words.tr: v. 使计算机化；用计算机做
words.ex: The school will computerise its records next year.
words.ex_cn: 学校明年将把记录电脑化。
words.en: To computerise something means to use a computer to control, organize, or automate a process or system.

words.ex: The deputy signed the document for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 代理人替经理签署了文件。
words.en: A deputy is a person who is appointed to act as a substitute for another, especially in a position of authority.

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.ex: He faced many hardships during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间经历了许多困苦。
words.en: Hardship refers to a situation that is difficult to endure because of lack of money, resources, or other basic necessities.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: His dismissal made him very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的被解雇让他非常难过。
words.en: The act of officially removing someone from their job, or the act of sending someone away or allowing them to leave.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.tr: adj. 运动的；身强力壮的；
words.ex: He is an athletic boy who loves running.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱跑步的运动型男孩。
words.en: Athletic is used to describe someone who is physically strong, fit, and good at sports, or something related to sports or physical activities.

words.ex: He is fortunate to have a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他很幸运拥有一份好工作。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is fortunate, you mean that they are lucky.

words.ex: He lost his job, which was a great misfortune.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，这是一场巨大的不幸。
words.en: An unfortunate condition or event.

words.tr: n. 总部；司令部；指挥部；
words.ex: The company's headquarters is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a company, organization, or military unit.

words.tr:
adj. 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的；
n. 活力；动力；
words.ex: The game has dynamic weather that changes every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有每小时变化的动态天气。
words.en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new ideas.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.ex: The flag is symbolical of freedom.
words.ex_cn: 这面旗帜象征着自由。
words.en: Representing something else by means of symbols or emblematic representations.

words.ex: The box has a cubic shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是立方体形状的。
words.en: Relating to or involving the cube or cubes.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.ex: The moon has a periodic cycle of phases.
words.ex_cn: 月亮的相位变化是周期性的。
words.en: Happening or appearing at regular intervals.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.ex: He made a strategic decision to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了一个有战略性的决定来省钱。
words.en: Relating to the identification of long-term or overall aims and interests and the means of achieving them.

words.ex: He solved a mathematical problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了一个数学问题。
words.en: Relating to or using mathematics; precise and exact.

words.tr: n. 柠檬汽水；柠檬饮料
words.ex: He drinks lemonade every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午喝柠檬水。
words.en: A drink made from lemon juice, water, and sugar.

words.ex: The teacher gave an authoritative answer.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了一个权威性的回答。
words.en: If something is authoritative, it is respected and accepted as true or correct because it comes from a reliable source.

words.ex: His motive was to help his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助家人。
words.en: Your motive for doing something is your reason for doing it.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.ex: He is a veteran player with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位经验丰富的老练球员。
words.en: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience in a particular field or activity, especially in the armed forces.

words.ex: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天很大可能会下雨。
words.en: The likelihood of something happening is how likely it is to happen.

words.ex: I like coffee, and she likes it likewise.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，她也喜欢。
words.en: You use likewise when you are comparing two methods, states, or situations and saying that they are similar.

words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着河边走。
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.ex: The team has a strong backup for the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍有一位强大的后援来代替队长。
words.en: A backup is a copy of a file or other item of data made in case the original is lost or damaged. It can also refer to support or assistance provided to someone or something.

words.ex: This book is the best-selling novel this year.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是今年最畅销的小说。
words.en: A best-selling product or book is one that many people buy.

words.ex: The birds sing at daylight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日光下歌唱。
words.en: Daylight is the natural light that comes from the sun during the day.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.tr:
n. 指纹；指印
v. 采指纹
words.ex: The police found his fingerprint on the glass.
words.ex_cn: 警察在玻璃上找到了他的指纹。
words.en: A fingerprint is a mark made by the pattern of ridges on the pad of a human finger, used for identification purposes.

words.ex: He stopped halfway to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他在半路停下来休息。
words.en: At or to a point midway between two others.

words.tr: n. 实际知识；技术；窍门
words.ex: He has the know-how to fix the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他有修理这台机器的诀窍。
words.en: Practical knowledge or expertise in a particular field or area.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.ex: At the outset, he was unsure about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 在开始时，他对这个计划并不确定。
words.en: The outset of something is the beginning of it.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.ex: The manager oversees the team's daily work.
words.ex_cn: 经理监督团队的日常工作。
words.en: To oversee means to watch and direct a piece of work, the people doing it, or the way it is done in order to ensure that it is done correctly.

words.tr: v. 使不知所措；使无法解决；击败；压垮；淹没
words.ex: The homework overwhelms her every night.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上的作业让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: To overwhelm means to bury or drown beneath a huge mass of something, or to defeat someone completely.

words.tr: n. 男推销员；男售货员；
words.ex: The salesman showed us new phones.
words.ex_cn: 那位男推销员给我们展示了新手机。
words.en: A salesman is a man whose job is to sell things, especially directly to shops or other businesses on behalf of a company.

words.ex: From my standpoint, this plan is too risky.
words.ex_cn: 从我的立场来看，这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: A standpoint is a particular way of considering something, or a particular attitude towards it.

words.ex: The teacher underlined the key point.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了这个关键点。
words.en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, especially in order to emphasize it.

words.tr: adj. 顺利的；宽裕的；有钱的
words.ex: He comes from a well-off family and never worries about money.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个顺利的家庭，从不为钱发愁。
words.en: Someone who is well-off is rich enough to be able to do and buy most of the things that they want.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: He lost weight by using his willpower.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借意志力减掉了体重。
words.en: Willpower is the ability to control yourself and to make yourself do things that are difficult or unpleasant.

words.ex: The children play in the backyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在后院玩耍。
words.en: A backyard is an area of land at the back of a house, often used for recreation or gardening.

words.ex: Please tell me beforehand if you can't come.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。
words.en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

words.ex: The scientist made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家在癌症研究中取得了突破。
words.en: A breakthrough is a significant development or achievement that helps to solve a problem or improve a situation.

words.tr:
n. 广播节目；电视节目；
v. 广播；播送；
words.ex: I listened to the morning broadcast on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我听了早上的广播节目。
words.en: To broadcast is to transmit (a program or some information) by radio or television.

words.ex: He made a box from cardboard.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸板做了一个盒子。
words.en: Cardboard is a stiff, heavy paper material that is used for making boxes and other packaging.

words.ex: This is a commonplace event in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 这在大城市里是件普通的事。
words.en: Something that is commonplace is ordinary and not very interesting.

words.ex: He owns the copyright to his novel.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这部小说的版权。
words.en: The exclusive legal right, given to an originator or an assignee to print, publish, perform, film, or record literary, artistic, or musical material, and to authorize others to do the same.

words.ex: The children play in the courtyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在庭院里玩耍。
words.en: An open area surrounded by buildings or walls, often found in the center of a complex or building.

words.ex: He works on his desktop every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在台式机上工作。
words.en: The top of a desk; a computer that is designed to be used on a desk.

words.ex: The bear left a footprint in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 熊在雪地上留下了足迹。
words.en: A footprint is a mark made by a foot or shoe on a surface.

words.ex: The framework of the house is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 房子的骨架是木制的。
words.en: A framework is a particular set of rules, ideas, or beliefs which you use in order to deal with problems or to decide what to do.

words.ex: He likes reading, and furthermore, he writes stories too.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读，而且他还写故事。
words.en: In addition to what has been said; moreover.

words.ex: They went to Bali for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们去巴厘岛度蜜月。
words.en: A honeymoon is a holiday taken by a newly married couple.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: The painting is considered a masterpiece by art critics.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画被艺术评论家视为杰作。
words.en: A masterpiece is a work of art such as a painting, film, or book that is made with great skill and is considered to be the best work of a particular artist or writer.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.ex: The people tried to overthrow the corrupt government.
words.ex_cn: 人民试图推翻腐败的政府。
words.en: To overthrow a government or a leader means to remove them from power, often by force.

words.ex: The company updated the payroll last Friday.
words.ex_cn: 公司上星期五更新了职工工资册。
words.en: A payroll is a list of employees and the amount of money they are to be paid, or the total amount of money paid to the employees of a company.

words.ex: He bought a secondhand bike for $50.
words.ex_cn: 他花50美元买了一辆二手自行车。
words.en: Something that is secondhand is not new and has been owned by someone else before.

words.tr:
n. 东南；
adj. 位于东南的；向东南的；
words.ex: The storm came from the southeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东南方向。
words.en: The southeast is the direction which is halfway between south and east.

words.ex: The spokesperson spoke clearly at the press conference.
words.ex_cn: 发言人在新闻发布会上清晰地发言。
words.en: A spokesperson is a person who speaks officially for a group or an organization.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: The plane's takeoff was delayed by strong wind.
words.ex_cn: 飞机的起飞因强风而延误了。
words.en: Takeoff is the beginning of a flight, when an aircraft leaves the ground.

words.ex: He bought new underwear for the summer.
words.ex_cn: 他为夏天买了新的内衣。
words.en: Clothing worn next to the skin under outer clothes.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: The books are on the shelf beside the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 书在过道旁边的架子上。
words.en: An aisle is a long narrow gap that people can walk along between rows of seats in a public building such as a church or between rows of shelves in a supermarket.

words.tr: adj. 有苦味的；激烈而不快的；痛苦的；刺痛的；
words.ex: The medicine tastes bitter.
words.ex_cn: 这种药尝起来很苦。
words.en: Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet. Feeling or showing anger, hurt, or resentment because of bad experiences or a sense of unjust treatment.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.ex: The child blew a bubble with gum.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用口香糖吹了一个气泡。
words.en: A bubble is a small ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass.

words.ex: A bug crawled on the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只小虫子爬在叶子上。
words.en: A bug is a small insect, or it can refer to a fault in a computer program or system.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.tr:
v. 爆裂；突然而起；
n. 爆裂；突然而起；
words.ex: The balloon burst when he blew too much air.
words.ex_cn: 当他吹入太多空气时，气球爆裂了。
words.en: If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out; used especially to describe the sound of something breaking open.

words.ex: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: If people cheer, they shout loudly to show their approval or to encourage someone who is doing something such as taking part in a game.

words.ex: The smoke made him choke.
words.ex_cn: 烟让他窒息。
words.en: If you choke, or if something chokes you, you cannot breathe properly because there is not enough air or because something is blocking your throat.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: The baby is crawling on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在地板上爬。
words.en: To move slowly on hands and knees or by dragging the body close to the ground.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.ex: The old man muttered a curse under his breath.
words.ex_cn: 老人低声嘟囔了一句诅咒。
words.en: A curse is a word or sentence that is used to wish evil or harm on someone or something.

words.ex: The dean gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 院长在毕业典礼上发表了演讲。
words.en: A dean is a senior official in a college or university, who is in charge of a faculty or department or a group of students.

words.ex: The children played on the deck of the ship.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在船的甲板上玩耍。
words.en: A deck is a floor-like surface on a ship, or a set of cards used in games. It can also mean to decorate or adorn something.

words.ex: The devil made him do it.
words.ex_cn: 魔鬼让他这么做的。
words.en: In Christian theology, the devil is the supreme spirit of evil, often represented as the tempter of humankind and the enemy of God and goodness.

words.ex: He drag the box across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子拖过地板。
words.en: To pull something along the ground, often with difficulty or effort.

words.ex: The rainwater drains into the street.
words.ex_cn: 雨水排入街道。
words.en: If you drain something, you remove the liquid from it, usually by pouring it away or by allowing it to flow away. If something drains, the liquid flows away from it.

words.tr:
v. 伪造；假装；冒充；
adj. 假的；冒充的；伪造的；
words.ex: He faked a signature to get the money.
words.ex_cn: 他伪造了一个签名来拿到钱。
words.en: If something is fake, it is not real, genuine, or true, but is made to appear so.

words.ex: Please fetch me a glass of water.
words.ex_cn: 请给我拿一杯水来。
words.en: If you fetch something or someone, you go to the place where they are and return with them.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.ex: The navy launched a large fleet to protect the coast.
words.ex_cn: 海军派出了一支大型舰队来保护海岸。
words.en: A fleet is a group of ships or vehicles that are controlled by one company or organization and are used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The car drove slowly through the fog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓驶过浓雾。
words.en: Fog is a thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface which obscures or restricts visibility (to a greater extent than mist; strictly, reducing visibility to below 1 km).

words.ex: He walked forth to meet the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去迎接太阳。
words.en: Forward in time, place, or order; onward.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The doctor checked his gut for signs of infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠道是否有感染迹象。
words.en: The gut refers to the stomach and other internal organs of an animal or person, often used to describe the digestive tract. It can also metaphorically represent courage or determination.

words.ex: The memory of the accident still haunts him.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故的记忆仍然长期困扰着他。
words.en: If something unpleasant haunts you, you keep thinking or worrying about it over a long period of time. A place that is haunted is believed to be visited regularly by a ghost.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.ex: He was sent to jail for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A place where people are kept as a punishment for a crime they have committed, or while they are waiting to go to court for their trial.

words.ex: He was sent to gaol for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被关进了监狱。
words.en: A place where criminals are kept as a punishment for their crimes.

words.ex: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
words.ex_cn: 他爬梯子去修屋顶。
words.en: A ladder is a piece of equipment consisting of a series of steps or rungs fixed between two upright lengths of wood, metal, or rope, used for climbing up or down something.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.ex: The soil is moist after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后土壤是潮湿的。
words.en: Slightly wet; damp or humid.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.ex: The baker used a metal mold to shape the cake.
words.ex_cn: 面包师用一个金属模具来塑造蛋糕。
words.en: A mold is a hollow container used to give shape to molten or hot liquid material when it cools and hardens. It can also refer to a fungus that grows on food or damp surfaces.

words.ex: The dog ran through the mud.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑过了泥地。
words.en: Mud is a sticky mixture of earth and water.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: He added an ounce of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: An ounce is a unit of weight used in Britain and the USA. There are sixteen ounces in a pound.

words.ex: He drank a pint of beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝了一品脱啤酒。
words.en: A pint is a unit of measurement for liquids. In Britain, it is equal to 568 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon. In the United States, it is equal to 473 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon.

words.ex: The riot broke out after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后爆发了骚乱。
words.en: A riot is a violent disturbance of the peace by a crowd.

words.ex: He used a long rod to reach the top shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根长杆够到顶层架子。
words.en: A rod is a long, thin, straight bar, especially one made of wood or metal.

words.ex: It was sheer luck that he won the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了比赛完全是运气。
words.en: Sheer is used to emphasize that a state or situation is complete and does not involve or is not mixed with anything else.

words.tr:
v. 拍；掴；拍击
n. 拍；掴；拍击
words.ex: He slapped the table in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地拍了桌子。
words.en: If you slap someone, you hit them with the palm of your hand.

words.ex: The slave worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is someone who is the legal property of another person and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: He rolled up his sleeve to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他卷起袖子洗手。
words.en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.

words.tr: n. 切片；薄片；部分；片段；
words.ex: She ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片面包。
words.en: A slice of something is a thin piece or portion of it.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: He felt deep sorrow when his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗去世时，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Sorrow is a feeling of deep sadness or regret.

words.tr:
n. 火花；火星；
v. 激发；
words.ex: The match produced a small spark.
words.ex_cn: 火柴产生了一个小火花。
words.en: A spark is a small fiery particle thrown off from a fire, alight in ashes, or produced by striking together two hard surfaces such as stone or metal.

words.tr:
v. 溢出；溅出
n. 溢出；溅出
words.ex: He spilled milk on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶洒在了地上。
words.en: To cause or allow (a liquid, powder, etc.) to flow or fall out of a container, usually by accident.

words.ex: He bought a stake in the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了这家新公司的股份。
words.en: A stake is a pointed stick or post that is pushed into the ground, for example to support a young tree. It can also refer to a share or interest in a business, situation, or system.

words.ex: The children starve without food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们没有食物就会挨饿。
words.en: To suffer or die from lack of food.

words.ex: He ordered a steak for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了一份牛排。
words.en: A steak is a slice of meat, especially beef, that is cooked by grilling or frying.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动；
n. 影响；支配；
words.ex: The tree branches sway in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树的枝条在风中摇摆。
words.en: To sway means to move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side. It can also mean to influence someone or something.

words.ex: He filled the tank with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把罐子装满了水。
words.en: A tank is a large container for holding liquid or gas, or a heavily armored fighting vehicle carrying guns and moving on a continuous articulated metal track.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.ex: The lid is tight on the jar.
words.ex_cn: 罐子的盖子很紧。
words.en: Something that is tight is fastened or fixed firmly and is not loose.

words.ex: It was an utter mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个完全的错误。
words.en: To say something or to make a sound with your voice; complete or absolute.

words.ex: He drives a red van to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆红色的货车去上班。
words.en: A van is a road vehicle used for transporting goods or people, usually larger than a car but smaller than a truck.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；落泪
v. 流泪；流出
words.ex: Her weep lasted for hours after the news.
words.ex_cn: 听到消息后，她的哭泣持续了数小时。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain.

words.ex: He wore a weird hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶怪异的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as weird, you mean that they are strange, unusual, or mysterious.

words.ex: The widow lives alone in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位寡妇独自住在一所小房子里。
words.en: A widow is a woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.ex: He wears a badge on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他衬衫上戴着一枚徽章。
words.en: A badge is a small piece of metal, plastic, or cloth which you wear in order to show people that you have a particular rank, job, or belong to a particular group.

words.tr:
n. 保释（金）
v. 保释；（往外）舀水
words.ex: He paid bail to get out of jail.
words.ex_cn: 他交了保释金以便出狱。
words.en: Bail is a sum of money that a person who has been accused of a crime pays to a law court so that they can be released until their trial. The payment is a way of making sure that the accused will return to court for trial.

words.ex: The bang woke me up at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响在午夜把我吵醒了。
words.en: A bang is a sudden loud noise such as the noise of an explosion.

words.ex: The bakery made a new batch of bread this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家面包店今天早上做了一批新面包。
words.en: A batch is a quantity or consignment of goods produced at one time.

words.ex: The satellite beams signals to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星向地球发射信号。
words.en: A beam is a long, thick piece of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof of a building. It can also refer to a line of light that shines from a bright object, or a smile that shows someone is very happy.

words.ex: The beast ran fast through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 那只野兽在森林里快速奔跑。
words.en: A beast is a large and dangerous animal.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.tr: n. 一束；一串；一群；大量
words.ex: A bunch of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A bunch of things is a group of them. A bunch of people is a group of them who are together or who are connected in some way.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅满足素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater means to provide food and drink at an event, often as a business service, or to provide what is needed or wanted by a particular person or group.

words.tr:
n. 寒冷；寒意；
v. 变冷；使冰冷；
words.ex: The chill of the morning made me wear a jacket.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的寒冷让我穿上了夹克。
words.en: A chill is a feeling of coldness, often accompanied by shivering. It can also refer to a feeling of fear or anxiety. As a verb, to chill means to make something cold, or to relax and take it easy.

words.ex: The queen wore a golden crown on her head.
words.ex_cn: 女王头上戴着一顶金皇冠。
words.en: A crown is a circular ornament, usually made of gold and jewels, which a king or queen wears on their head at official ceremonies. It can also refer to the top part of something, such as a tooth or a hill, or to the act of making someone a king or queen by placing a crown on their head.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: He dare not speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you dare to do something, you are brave enough to do it, even though it may be dangerous or shocking or may cause trouble for you.

words.ex: They deem this plan too risky.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: If you deem something to be the case, you consider that it is the case.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.tr:
n. 厄运；毁灭；死亡
v. 注定；判决
words.ex: The old prophecy spoke of doom for the kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 古老的预言说这个王国将遭遇厄运。
words.en: Doom is a terrible fate or destiny that you cannot avoid, especially death or destruction.

words.ex: He gave a dumb answer to the simple question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个简单的问题给出了一个愚笨的回答。
words.en: If someone is dumb, they are unable to speak. If you describe someone or something as dumb, you mean that they are stupid or silly.

words.ex: He is an earnest student who always finishes his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个认真的学生，总是完成作业。
words.en: If you are earnest about something, you are serious about it and your intentions are honest and sincere.

words.ex: The freight train carried boxes to the city.
words.ex_cn: 货运列车把箱子运到了城市。
words.en: Freight refers to goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft. It can also mean the charge for such transportation.

words.ex: The children said they saw a ghost in the old house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们说他们在老房子里看到了一个鬼。
words.en: A ghost is the spirit of a dead person that some people believe they can see or feel.

words.ex: The gossip about the CEO made everyone shocked.
words.ex_cn: 关于CEO的流言蜚语让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: Gossip is informal conversation or reports about other people's private lives, which might be unkind or not true.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.tr:
n. 冰雹；
v. 把…誉为；
words.ex: The hail broke many car windows.
words.ex_cn: 冰雹打碎了许多汽车窗户。
words.en: Hail is small balls of ice that fall like rain from the sky. It can also mean to call out to someone in order to attract their attention, or to praise someone enthusiastically.

words.tr:
v. 悬挂；吊；
n. 悬挂；
words.ex: He hangs a picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一幅画挂在墙上。
words.en: To hang something means to attach it to something else so that it is supported from above and does not touch the ground.

words.ex: The ship docked at the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbor is a place on the coast where ships may moor in shelter, especially one protected from rough water by piers, jetties, and other artificial structures.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.ex: He made a mistake in haste.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙中犯了一个错误。
words.en: Haste is the quality of doing something quickly, sometimes too quickly so that you are careless and make mistakes.

words.ex: The horse eats hay every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这匹马每天早上吃干草。
words.en: Hay is grass which has been cut and dried so that it can be used to feed animals.

words.ex: The city was covered in haze this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上这座城市被雾霾笼罩。
words.en: Haze is a light mist or fog, especially one caused by the heat of the sun or by pollution.

words.ex: He fears going to hell after death.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕死后去地狱。
words.en: Hell is a place of suffering and punishment in some religions, where bad people are believed to go after they die.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. It can also refer to a hard mass formed in a tree trunk at the intersection with a branch, or a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, used especially by ships and aircraft.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the lamb every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂羔羊。
words.en: A lamb is a young sheep.

words.tr: n. 一圈；（人坐着时）大腿部；
words.ex: He ran three laps around the track.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑道上跑了三圈。
words.en: The upper part of the legs of a seated person; a single turn or round in a race or other competition.

words.tr:
n. 漏洞；泄露；
v. 漏；泄露；
words.ex: The leak in the roof caused water to drip inside.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的漏洞导致水滴进屋里。
words.en: If a container or pipe leaks, or if it leaks a substance such as liquid or gas, the substance comes out of it accidentally because there is a hole or crack in it.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.ex: They stayed in a small lodge near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小屋里。
words.en: A lodge is a small house in the country, especially one that is used by people on holiday or by people taking part in a sport such as skiing or hunting. As a verb, to lodge means to stay somewhere, especially temporarily, or to formally submit something, such as a complaint or an application.

words.tr: n. 勋爵；主；上帝；统治者；
words.ex: The lord lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位勋爵住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A lord is a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain, or a man who has authority or control over others.

words.ex: He hammered the nail into the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉子敲进了木头里。
words.en: A nail is a thin pointed piece of metal that is hammered into materials as a fastener. It can also refer to the hard covering at the end of fingers and toes. As a verb, to nail means to fasten something with a nail or to catch or accomplish something successfully.

words.tr: adj. 整洁的；整齐的；有条理的
words.ex: He keeps his desk neat.
words.ex_cn: 他保持书桌整洁。
words.en: Neat things are tidy, smart, or carefully arranged.

words.tr:
n. 窝；鸟巢；
v. 筑巢；
words.ex: The bird built a nest in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在树上筑了一个窝。
words.en: A nest is a structure made by a bird for laying eggs and sheltering its young. It can also refer to a place where insects or other animals lay eggs or raise their young. As a verb, to nest means to build or use a nest.

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.ex: The cat licked its paw.
words.ex_cn: 猫舔它的爪子。
words.en: The foot of an animal that has claws or nails, such as a cat, dog, or bear.

words.tr:
n. 大头针；
v. 固定；
words.ex: She stuck a pin on the map.
words.ex_cn: 她在地图上别了一枚大头针。
words.en: A pin is a small piece of metal with a sharp point at one end and a round head at the other, used especially for fastening pieces of cloth together.

words.tr:
n. 管子；管道；烟斗；
v. 吹笛；以管输送；
words.ex: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了坏掉的管子。
words.en: A pipe is a long, round, hollow object, usually made of metal or plastic, through which a liquid or gas can flow.

words.ex: The farmer ploughs the field every spring.
words.ex_cn: 农民每年春天都犁地。
words.en: A plough is a large farming implement with one or more blades fixed in a frame, drawn over soil to turn it over and cut furrows in preparation for the planting of seeds. It can also mean to move forward with difficulty or to work hard at something.

words.tr:
n. 塞子；
v. 插上；
words.ex: The sink is clogged because the plug is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 水槽堵塞了，因为塞子卡住了。
words.en: A plug is a small object at the end of a wire that is used for connecting a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity. It is also a piece of material that is used for blocking a hole.

words.ex: The priest said a prayer for the sick.
words.ex_cn: 牧师为病人祈祷。
words.en: A priest is a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in a Christian church.

words.tr:
n. 长队；
v. 排队；
words.ex: There is a long queue at the ticket counter.
words.ex_cn: 售票处排着一条长队。
words.en: A queue is a line of people or vehicles waiting for something.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.ex: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.

words.ex: He hurt his rib when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了肋骨。
words.en: A rib is one of the long curved bones that are connected to the spine and surround the chest.

words.tr:
n. 烤肉；烘烤；
adj. 烤的；焙的；
v. 烤；烘烤；
words.ex: We had roast for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们吃了烤肉。
words.en: To cook food, such as meat, in an oven or over a fire.

words.ex: The loud noise roused him from sleep.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音把他从睡梦中唤醒了。
words.en: If someone rouses you when you are sleeping or if you rouse, you wake up. / To rouse someone means to make them stop doing something and start doing something else.

words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来暖和它们。
words.en: To move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of something with firm pressure.

words.tr:
n. 袋子；
v. 劫掠；
words.ex: He carried the apples in a burlap sack.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果装在一个麻布袋里。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material, used for storing or carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment or the act of looting a place.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.ex: He sealed the envelope with glue.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶水把信封封上了。
words.en: A seal is a device or substance that is used to close off or fasten an opening or container, making it airtight or watertight. It can also refer to a marine mammal with flippers for swimming.

words.ex: The tree casts a long shadow at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 夕阳下，树投下长长的影子。
words.en: A shadow is a dark shape on a surface that is made when something stands between a light and the surface.

words.ex: He shaves every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刮胡子。
words.en: To shave means to remove hair from the face or body by cutting it close to the skin with a razor.

words.ex: The children played on the shore of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖岸玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water.

words.tr: v. 射击；拍摄（电影）；疾驰；“shoot”的过去式和过去分词； n. 照片；射击；射门；
words.ex: He shot the target with his gun.
words.ex_cn: 他用枪射击了目标。
words.en: A shot is an act of shooting a gun, or the sound that this makes. It can also refer to an attempt to do something, a photograph, or an injection.

words.ex: He felt guilt for his sin of lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因撒谎的罪行感到内疚。
words.en: Sin is an action or behaviour that is considered to be morally wrong according to religious or social laws.

words.tr:
n. 草图；素描；概述
v. 草拟；速写；简述
words.ex: He made a quick sketch of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他快速画出了房子的草图。
words.en: A sketch is a simple, quickly-made drawing that does not have many details. It can also mean a short description or account of something.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.ex: He smashed the glass with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把玻璃打碎了。
words.en: To break something into pieces violently and noisily, or to cause something to do this by dropping, throwing, or hitting it.

words.ex: The city has heavy smog in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市冬天有严重的雾霾。
words.en: Smog is a mixture of smoke and fog, or a similar mixture of air pollutants, which can be harmful to health.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.ex: He sows seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都在花园里播种。
words.en: To sow means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.tr:
n. 喷雾；
v. 喷洒；
words.ex: She used a spray to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 她用喷雾清洁了窗户。
words.en: Spray can refer to a liquid that is blown or driven through the air in the form of tiny drops, or to the act of applying such a liquid.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；重要的；
n. 主要产品；主要部分；主食；
words.ex: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
words.ex_cn: 大米是许多亚洲国家的主要食物。
words.en: A staple is a basic food that is eaten regularly and in such quantities that it constitutes a dominant portion of a standard diet for a given people, supplying a large fraction of energy needs and generally forming a significant proportion of the intake of other nutrients as well.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.ex: The cow eats straw from the barn.
words.ex_cn: 牛吃谷仓里的稻草。
words.en: A straw is a thin tube of paper or plastic that you use to suck a drink into your mouth.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.tr:
adj. 迅速的；敏捷的；快的；
n. 雨燕；
words.ex: The swift runner won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位迅速的跑步者赢得了比赛。
words.en: moving or capable of moving at great speed, or happening within a very short time; fast.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: She picked up a thread from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她从布料上捡起一根线。
words.en: A thread is a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving. It can also refer to a theme or idea that connects parts of a story or discussion.

words.ex: The rocket's thrust lifted it into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 火箭的推力将它送上了天空。
words.en: To thrust something somewhere means to push it there quickly and forcefully. A thrust is also a powerful push or movement.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.tr: n. 象征物；标志；代金券；代币；
words.ex: The dove is a token of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征物。
words.en: A token is something that represents or stands for something else, especially a piece of metal or plastic that you can use instead of money in some machines or as a symbol of a particular feeling or event.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.ex: He tosses the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To throw something, especially something light, with a quick, light motion.

words.ex: He placed the cups on a tray.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个托盘上。
words.en: A tray is a flat container, usually made of wood, plastic, or metal, with raised edges, used for carrying things such as food or drinks.

words.ex: The car has a flat tyre.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个瘪了的轮胎。
words.en: A tyre is a thick piece of rubber which is fitted onto the wheels of vehicles such as cars, buses, and bicycles in order to make them move smoothly and safely.

words.ex: Long hours of work tire him.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的工作让他感到疲倦。
words.en: If something tires you or if you tire, you feel that you have used a lot of energy and you want to rest or sleep.

words.tr:
n. 鞭子
v. 鞭打；抽打；突然移动
words.ex: The farmer used a whip to guide the horse.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用鞭子赶马。
words.en: To whip means to hit a person or animal with a whip, or to move something quickly and suddenly.

words.tr:
v. 叫喊
n. 喊叫
words.ex: He yells when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时会大喊。
words.en: If you yell, you shout loudly, usually because you are excited, angry, or in pain.
